name: Adelaide’s ranch bedroom
description: Adelaide put her writing desk where she can see the orchard rows. Her riding gloves hang beside the window, and the good quilt stays on the bed even when she comes in with dust on her boots.
details: A leather-bound ledger and inkwell sit on the writing desk.
A set of old sheet music rests on top of the wardrobe.
A pair of well-worn riding gloves hangs from a peg near the window.
activities: Pick an old song for Adelaide to sing
Plan a supper around the orchard harvest
windowOutlook: Open fields and orchard rows stretching toward the river with distant sandstone hills.
interiorStyle: Cream plaster walls, tobacco-brown wooden furniture, a faded brick-red quilt on the bed, and a brass lamp on the desk.

name: Agnes’s downstairs suite
description: Downstairs at the boardinghouse, Agnes has a rocker big enough to curl up in with a book. The little desk is for her own letters. A bucket by the door catches the dirt from her garden tools.
details: A worn copy of local history sits open on the reading chair.
A trowel and pruning shears rest in a bucket by the door.
A stack of letters tied with string occupies one corner of the desk.
activities: Read a chapter of local history aloud
Plan what to plant in the side yard
windowOutlook: A side yard with a small garden plot and the river slope beyond the fence.
interiorStyle: Faded indigo walls, a brass bed with a plain cotton coverlet, a wooden rocker by the window, and lamplight from an oil lamp on the desk.

name: Alma’s room above Lantern Court
description: Alma’s mustard-yellow coverlet is the first thing you see from the door. Her recipe notebook lives on the little table, but on her day off she’d rather pull the old dance card out of her trunk.
details: A cloth-bound recipe notebook lies on the table with a pencil beside it.
A folded dance card rests inside the lid of the trunk.
A set of embroidered linen napkins sits in a basket near the bed.
activities: Dream up a supper from her market notes
Try a dance from Alma’s old dance card
windowOutlook: The alley behind Lantern Row with neighboring rooftops and a slice of evening sky.
interiorStyle: Cream plaster walls with a mustard-yellow coverlet on the bed, a simple wooden table and chair, and a single oil lamp on the windowsill.

name: Annalise’s room on Main Street
description: A wooden stereoscope shares Annalise’s shelf with a little stack of glass slides. There’s room for two at the table if she moves the coffee grinder. Finished portrait plates stay turned inward in their crate.
details: A stack of finished portrait plates leans against the wall in a wooden crate.
A hand-crank coffee grinder rests on the table next to a tin of grounds.
A wooden stereoscope with a small pile of glass slides sits on the shelf.
activities: Grind coffee and pick a favorite slide
windowOutlook: A narrow view down Main Street toward the river terrace with cottonwood trees and passing wagons.
interiorStyle: Plain plaster walls with a single brass oil lamp, a wooden chair pulled up to the table, faded indigo curtain at the window, and worn floorboards.

name: August’s room at the coach station
description: August keeps a small room at the coach station with a cot, a shelf of books, and a narrow table for drawing. A borrowed violin case leans against the wall. A few potted plants sit on the windowsill.
details: A stack of books on local plants rests on the shelf.
A practice violin sits inside an open case on the table.
Several pencil drawings of distant hills are pinned to the wall.
activities: Learn a few notes on the practice violin
Sketch the bluffs from the window
windowOutlook: The window shows the dusty yard behind the station and a line of low bluffs in the distance.
interiorStyle: The room has rough plank walls, a faded brick-red blanket on the cot, a simple wooden table, and shelves made from old crates.

name: Beatrice’s cottage room
description: Beatrice keeps a room in the valley cottage with a bed, a small table, and a window box of herbs. A stack of novels sits on the shelf and botanical sketches hang on the wall. A mended quilt covers the bed.
details: A stack of novels rests on the shelf near the bed.
Several botanical sketches are pinned above the table.
A mended quilt with a simple pattern lies on the bed.
activities: Match leaves to the botanical sketches
Take turns reading from a favorite novel
windowOutlook: The window shows the garden plot behind the cottage and a line of cottonwoods along the irrigation ditch.
interiorStyle: The room has cream plaster walls, a faded brick-red quilt, a wooden table with two chairs, and a small shelf holding books and sketch paper.

name: Belle Sutter's private room
description: Belle keeps a compact room above Lantern Row with a narrow bed, a wash basin on a stand, and a wooden chair under the lamp. A small table holds a deck of cards and a bottle of whiskey. The space stays quiet once the street noise fades.
details: A pair of worn dancing slippers rests under the bed frame.
A deck of cards sits in a small wooden box on the table.
An empty whiskey glass stands on the basin stand.
windowOutlook: The window looks out over the narrow alley behind the row houses toward a row of cottonwood trees.
interiorStyle: The room has cream plaster walls, a faded indigo bed cover, a brass lamp on the table, and a single wooden chair with a worn seat.

name: Ben Crowell's private room
description: Ben keeps a boardinghouse room with a bed, a small table, and a closed wooden case for mine papers. A checkerboard sits on the table with a few books stacked beside it. Family letters rest in a tin box on the shelf.
details: A wooden checkerboard with carved pieces sits on the table.
A few books on local history are stacked beside the bed.
A tin box holding family letters rests on the shelf.
activities: Read from one of the history books
windowOutlook: The window looks across a small courtyard toward the side of the next boardinghouse and a stand of cottonwoods.
interiorStyle: The room has cream plaster walls, a faded indigo blanket, a brass lamp, and a simple wooden table with two straight chairs.

name: Bess’s room at the Red Sash
residenceType: The Red Sash private resident rooms
description: Bess keeps a private room at the Red Sash with a red-ribbon hat stand by the door. A small desk holds sheets of lyrics and a stack of fabric swatches. Bright mended cushions cover the single chair and the edge of the bed.
details: A red-ribbon hat stand holds two theater bonnets and a folded shawl.
The small desk has a stack of handwritten lyric sheets and a tin of pins.
Brightly patched cushions sit on the chair and along the bed frame.
activities: Try a chorus from her comic song sheets
Pick a bonnet for her next stage number
windowOutlook: A narrow view of the neighboring courtyard wall and a single cottonwood branch.
interiorStyle: Small square room with cream plaster walls, a brass bedstead, one wooden chair, a washstand, and an oil lamp on the desk. The floor is bare boards with a faded rag rug.

name: Birdie’s room on Main Street
description: Birdie keeps a private room above a Main Street business. Dusty boots stand by the door. An oil lamp sits on a small table beside the bed.
details: A leather sheath and two throwing knives lie on the washstand.
A whiskey flask and a tin cup rest on the bedside table.
A deck of worn cards is stacked beside a small notebook of penciled notes.
activities: Play a hand of five-card draw
Teach each other a card trick
windowOutlook: A high view of the alley and the back wall of the next building.
interiorStyle: Small square room with cream plaster walls, a brass bed, one chair, a washstand, and a trunk. Oil lamp on the table, faded indigo blanket, bare boards with a small rug.

name: Burke’s room off Main Street
description: Burke keeps a compact room above a Main Street storefront. A worn blanket covers the narrow bed. A straight chair holds a folded coat and a small dish for keys sits on the washstand.
details: A half-empty wine bottle and one clean glass rest on the washstand shelf.
A wooden box of tailoring chalk and thread spools sits beside the chair.
A folded sailing chart is tucked under the edge of the blanket.
activities: Plot an imaginary voyage on the river chart
Sketch a shirt Burke might actually wear
windowOutlook: A slice of Main Street roofline and the upper branches of a cottonwood.
interiorStyle: Narrow room with cream plaster walls, one brass bed, a straight chair, a washstand, and a small trunk at the foot of the bed. Oil lamp on the washstand, bare boards underfoot.

name: Caleb’s room in the Pike cottage
description: Caleb keeps a private room in the Pike cottage. Boat sketches are pinned to one wall above a sturdy chair he built himself. A fiddle case leans against the bed frame.
details: Several rolled boat sketches rest on a low shelf beside the bed.
The handmade chair has a smooth oak seat and a straight back.
A fiddle case and a stack of sheet music sit on the floor by the window.
activities: Pick out a fiddle tune by ear
windowOutlook: A low view across the riverbank willows and a stretch of moving water.
interiorStyle: Square room with plank walls, a simple iron bed, the handmade chair, a small table, and a shelf for tools and sketches. Oil lamp on the table, cottonwood green blanket on the bed.

name: Clara’s room by the railhead
description: Clara keeps a private room in the eastbank lodging house. A narrow bed stands along one wall. A small table holds her sketchbook and camera cloth.
details: A few carefully hung photographic prints are pinned to the wall above the table.
A sketchbook with drawings of workers rests on the table.
A repaired camera cloth is folded beside the sketchbook.
activities: Pick two prints that belong side by side
Draw the same view in separate sketches
windowOutlook: The window shows the side of the next lodging building and a patch of open sky above the railhead yards.
interiorStyle: Plaster walls with brick red trim, a wooden bed, a small table, and two chairs. A brass lamp provides lamplit amber light over the table.

name: Cole's Canvas Space
description: Cole keeps a separate canvas sleeping space at Crowcut Hollow. A low cot occupies most of the floor. A small wooden box sits at the foot of the cot.
details: A patched blanket is folded at the end of the cot.
Two borrowed adventure books are stacked beside the wooden box.
A harmonica rests on top of the box.
activities: Play a tune on the harmonica
Read a page from one of the adventure books
windowOutlook: The open flap shows a rocky bluff face and a narrow path leading toward the mining works.
interiorStyle: Canvas walls and roof with a dirt floor, a low wooden cot, and a single lantern on a crate. The wooden box serves as both seat and storage.

name: Cora's Upstairs Room
description: Cora keeps a private room above Lantern Court. The floor is cleared in the center for practice. A peg rail on one wall holds ribbons and a few bright fabric pieces.
details: A pair of good leather shoes stands side by side under the peg rail.
A notebook of dance calls rests on a small stand near the cleared floor space.
A fiddle tune book sits open on the windowsill.
activities: Practice a new dance call together
Try on ribbons for a performance
windowOutlook: The window faces the narrow alley between buildings and a neighboring porch roof.
interiorStyle: Wood plank walls with lamplit amber light, a single bed against the back wall, a peg rail, and open floor space. A brass hook holds a small mirror.

name: Daisy's Valley Room
description: Daisy keeps a private room in one of the valley cottages. A narrow bed sits against the inner wall beneath a small shelf. A plain table holds her notebook and a tin box for savings.
details: A leather-bound notebook lies open on the table with handwritten notes on cheese batches and aging times.
A stack of folded letters from travelers rests beside the notebook, each tied with string.
Pressed flowers sit between the pages of a small book on the shelf above the bed.
activities: Compare notes on a new cheese recipe
Read one of the travel letters aloud
windowOutlook: The single window looks onto the side wall of the next cottage and a row of cottonwood trees beyond.
interiorStyle: Cream plaster walls with one small window, a wooden bed frame, a low table with two chairs, and a shelf holding books and the tin box. A faded indigo blanket covers the bed.

name: Daniel’s telegraph-key room
description: Daniel keeps a private room in the boatmen's boardinghouse at the Railhead. Technical books stand on a shelf and a tidy box holds his letters. A comfortable chair faces the window.
details: A brass mechanical telegraph key model sits on the shelf beside the books.
A small stack of family photographs leans against the wall near the bed.
A correspondence box with labeled compartments rests on the table.
activities: Tap each other’s names in Morse code
Choose a photo for the top of his desk
windowOutlook: view across the yard to the neighboring roof and a line of cottonwood trees
interiorStyle: plain plank walls, faded indigo blanket on the bed, wooden shelf, small table, one comfortable chair, oil lamp, scuffed floor

name: Deacon’s room in River Ward
description: Deacon keeps a small private room in River Ward. A worn blanket covers the bed and a basin stands on a stand near the door. Boots rest by the threshold.
details: A battered hymnal with marked pages lies on the table.
A half-full whiskey bottle sits on the floor beside the bed.
A folded black coat hangs on a peg by the door.
activities: Try the harmony on an old hymn
Trade a story over a little whiskey
windowOutlook: view of the alley wall and a patch of sky above the rooftops
interiorStyle: rough plank walls, faded blanket on the iron bed, small table, basin on a stand, peg for clothes, oil lamp, dusty floor

name: Lucía's courtyard room
description: Lucía keeps a private room off the courtyard in River Ward. Medical books stand closed on a shelf and flowering pots line the windowsill. A small card table and writing desk take up one corner.
details: A pack of worn playing cards sits on the card table.
Two small pots of flowering herbs stand on the windowsill.
A Spanish poetry volume lies on the writing desk.
activities: Read a poem from the volume
windowOutlook: direct view into the shared courtyard with potted plants and a low wall
interiorStyle: adobe walls, terracotta floor, wooden shelf, card table with two chairs, writing desk, cotton curtains, warm lamplight

name: Edith’s room with the blue curtains
description: Edith keeps a private room above Lantern Court. Blue curtains cover the single window and a narrow wardrobe holds her few good dresses. A straight chair sits by a small table where she keeps her sketches.
details: A stack of architectural sketches on thin paper rests on the side table.
One tailored wool jacket with neat stitching hangs inside the wardrobe.
A folded swimming costume lies at the bottom of a trunk under the bed.
activities: Design a jacket on a scrap of paper
Sketch a building front from the window
windowOutlook: narrow view of the next building's brick wall and a strip of cottonwood leaves
interiorStyle: cream plaster walls, blue cotton curtains, one solid wardrobe, iron bedstead, wooden chair and table, lamplit amber light, worn floorboards

name: Eliza’s room by the valley
description: Eliza keeps a room in a valley cottage with a bed under the east window and a small writing table against the opposite wall. Field notebooks and a folded map lie beside a stack of school primers. A wool throw is draped over the foot of the bed.
details: A pair of field glasses rests on the windowsill next to a notebook of bird sightings.
A bundle of letters from former students sits in a shallow wooden box.
A simple wooden flute lies on top of a music book.
activities: Look for birds through the field glasses
Learn the refrain of a flute tune
windowOutlook: orchard trees and a stretch of irrigated fields with low hills beyond
interiorStyle: cream plaster walls, faded indigo throw, pine writing table and chair, brass bed, rag rug, single oil lamp, open shelf of books

name: Esther Wynn's room
residenceType: Calder House staff and rented rooms
description: Esther keeps a second-floor room at Calder House with a narrow bed against the north wall and a writing table under the window. Legal volumes and language dictionaries sit on a low shelf beside a tin box of family letters. A wool shawl hangs on the back of a straight chair.
details: A leather-bound notebook holds half-finished word squares and anagrams written in different inks.
A folded theater program from a traveling company lists the evening's comic sketches.
A brass oil lamp with a clear chimney sits on the table next to a small stack of blank petition forms.
activities: Read a scene from the theater program aloud
windowOutlook: brick wall of the next building and a strip of cottonwood tops beyond it
interiorStyle: cream plaster walls, faded indigo bedspread, pine floor with a single rag rug, brass bed frame, plain wooden table and chair, one oil lamp

name: Etta’s room in Cinder Bluffs
description: Etta keeps a small room above the forge with a narrow bed, a basin on a stand, and a chair pulled close to an oil lamp. A tin cup and a bottle of widows' whiskey sit on the windowsill. Folded work shirts rest on a trunk at the foot of the bed.
details: A whetstone and a finished knife with a plain handle lie on a folded cloth.
A bundle of old letters tied with twine rests inside the trunk lid.
A small glass bottle of fog-colored liquid sits beside the whiskey.
activities: Read an old letter over whiskey
Sketch a new handle for the pocketknife
windowOutlook: alley between the forge and the next building, with a strip of sky above
interiorStyle: brick-red walls, faded cottonwood-green blanket, scarred pine trunk, iron bed frame, enamel basin on a stand, one oil lamp

name: Eve’s room near the trail
description: Eve keeps a ground-floor room behind the coach station with a cot, a repaired wooden chair, and a wall peg for her saddle. A row of well-oiled bridles and a small stack of books rest on a plank shelf. A dented tin lamp sits on a crate turned into a nightstand.
details: A set of route notes written on folded paper lists distances between water stops.
A leather saddlebag with fresh stitching holds spare straps and a whetstone.
A small harmonica lies on top of a thin book of trail songs.
activities: Play a trail song on the harmonica
Pick the prettiest stop on her route
windowOutlook: dusty yard with a hitching rail and low hills in the distance
interiorStyle: whitewashed plank walls, tobacco-brown blanket on the cot, worn leather gear on pegs, pine crate table, single oil lamp, bare floorboards

name: Faye’s room off Main Street
description: A narrow bed sits under a single window in Faye Mercer's room above Main Street. A small table holds a whiskey bottle and two glasses. A guitar case leans against the wall near a straight-backed chair.
details: A whetstone rests on the table beside the whiskey bottle for keeping blades sharp.
A stack of song sheets sits on the chair seat with handwritten notes in the margins.
A cast-iron skillet on the floor holds the remains of a late breakfast.
activities: Strum the chorus of a trail song
Plan what to cook in the cast-iron skillet
windowOutlook: A view of the dusty Main Street and the brick buildings across the way.
interiorStyle: Small rectangular room with cream plaster walls, faded indigo curtains, a brass bed frame, worn wooden floorboards, and a single oil lamp on the table.

name: Felix's room
residenceType: Calder House staff and rented rooms
description: Felix Avery's room at the Calder House features a bed with a tailored coverlet and a small desk. A stack of sheet music sits beside a sewing kit. A deck of cards rests on the nightstand.
details: A needle and thread in the sewing kit mend a fine shirt draped over the chair.
A violin case stands against the wall next to the sheet music.
A ledger with personal accounts lies closed on the desk.
activities: Play a tune on the violin from the sheet music
Deal a hand of cards at the desk
windowOutlook: A view of the neighboring hotel courtyard and a few cottonwood trees.
interiorStyle: Modest hotel room with cream plaster walls, tobacco brown coverlet, brass bed frame, polished wooden desk, and lamplit amber light from an oil lamp.

name: Finn’s room near the rail yard
description: Finn Booker's room in the Railhead district holds a narrow bed and a sturdy wooden table. A coffee pot sits on a small stove in the corner. A map of the rail lines hangs on the wall above the table.
details: A tin cup for black coffee rests on the table next to a folded newspaper.
A leather-bound notebook with rail measurements lies open on the bed.
A pair of steel calipers sits beside the map for checking track spacing.
activities: Trace a day trip on the rail map
Split the newspaper over black coffee
windowOutlook: A view across the river to the east-bank rail yards and temporary structures.
interiorStyle: Compact room with sun-warmed ochre walls, brick red blanket on the bed, brass lamp, plain wooden table and chair, and scuffed floorboards.

name: Flora's room
description: Flora Vale's cottage room in Cottonwood Valley has a bed pushed against one wall and a work table under the window. Seed envelopes and drawing paper cover the table surface. A small vase of flowers stands on a shelf.
details: A set of colored pencils lies beside a half-finished sketch of orchard grafts.
A bundle of dry seed envelopes sits tied with string on the table corner.
A wooden flute rests on the bed for playing music in the evenings.
activities: Add color to a botanical sketch with the pencils
Play a simple melody together on the flute
windowOutlook: A view of the irrigated orchard rows and the river beyond the cottage yard.
interiorStyle: Small cottage room with cream plaster walls, faded indigo curtains, cottonwood green blanket, simple wooden table and bed, and natural light from the single window.

name: Gabriel's Room
residenceType: Livery cottage and separate forge room
description: Gabriel keeps a private room beside the livery cottage. Carefully maintained tools hang on one wall away from the living space. Cookbooks sit on a shelf above a sturdy table holding music sheets.
details: A well-oiled farrier hammer rests in a rack beside the door.
A stack of printed music sheets lies on the corner of the table.
A wooden boat model sits unfinished on a side bench.
activities: Look through a cookbook for a new recipe
Sand a piece of the boat model
windowOutlook: A side view of the livery yard fence and a row of cottonwoods along the riverbank.
interiorStyle: A plain room with brick-red trim on cream walls, a scarred pine table, a single brass lamp, and a bed with a faded cotton coverlet.

name: Hank's Room
description: Hank keeps a compact private room in Cinder Bluffs. Dusty boots wait by the door beside a washstand and an oil lamp. A bed occupies the far wall.
details: A deck of cards sits in a small tin on the shelf above the bed.
A whetstone and short iron file rest on a low bench.
A thick wool blanket is folded at the foot of the bed.
activities: Play a few hands of cards
Sharpen a small blade on the whetstone
windowOutlook: A view across the bluff edge toward low hills and scattered brush.
interiorStyle: A plain room with brick-red accents on cream plaster, a wooden bench, an iron bedstead, and a single oil lamp on the washstand.

name: Hazel’s room on the east bank
description: Hazel keeps a small east-bank room with a folding desk pushed against one wall. A hand-drawn business sign leans beside the door and a riding coat hangs from a peg. Family photographs stand on a narrow shelf above the desk.
details: A leather-bound ledger rests open on the folding desk with columns of arithmetic entries.
A pair of polished riding boots sits under the coat peg beside a folded blanket.
A small stack of travel pamphlets lies on the shelf next to the photographs.
activities: Sketch a sign for Hazel’s delivery business
Plan a scenic ride from her route notes
windowOutlook: A narrow view of the east-bank courtyard wall and a single cottonwood tree against the sky.
interiorStyle: A compact room with cream plaster walls, a brass lamp on the desk, a faded indigo blanket on the iron bed, and a wooden chair pulled up to the folding desk.

name: Honey’s room on Lantern Row
description: Honey keeps a compact private room in Lantern Row. Dusty boots stand by the door next to a washstand holding an oil lamp. A simple bed fills the remaining space.
details: A small bottle of oil sits on the washstand beside a folded towel.
A tin cup for whiskey rests on a low shelf near the bed.
A pair of worn walking shoes lies under the chair.
activities: Plot a moonlit walk through town
Trade the best stories from Lantern Row
windowOutlook: A close view of the neighboring building wall and a sliver of night sky above the alley.
interiorStyle: A narrow room with sun-warmed ochre walls, a wooden washstand, an iron bed with a plain blanket, and a single oil lamp casting lamplit amber light.

name: Inés’s room off the courtyard
description: Inés has a private room opening onto the Salcedo courtyard in River Ward. Woven cloth hangs over the bed frame and a market notebook sits on a small table. Borrowed music sheets lie beside flowers in a jar.
details: A stack of handwritten music sheets rests on the table next to a simple wooden flute.
A market notebook with produce tallies and customer notes lies open on the shelf.
A small basket of dried herbs and a wooden spoon sit on the windowsill.
activities: Play a duet by trading flute phrases
Choose herbs for a market-day supper
windowOutlook: A view across the shared courtyard to the adobe wall and a line of cottonwood trees.
interiorStyle: Square room with cream plaster walls, a low wooden bed with woven blankets, a small pine table under the window, terracotta floor tiles, and a single oil lamp on the shelf.

name: Iris Keene's rented room
residenceType: Calder House staff and rented rooms
description: Iris rents a compact room above the hotel on Main Street. A writing table holds stacks of books and a basket of discarded drafts sits nearby. Her travel bag rests by the door, always half-packed.
details: A leather-bound notebook lies open on the writing table with a fountain pen across its pages.
A wooden camera case with brass fittings stands against the wall beside a stack of glass plates.
A set of word-game cards in a tin box rests on the nightstand next to the oil lamp.
activities: Work through a new word game together
Examine glass plates from the camera
windowOutlook: A narrow view of the hotel courtyard with cottonwood branches and a brick wall beyond.
interiorStyle: Small square room with cream plaster walls, a brass bed against one side, a scarred pine writing table under the window, faded indigo curtains, and a single oil lamp on the nightstand.

name: Isaac’s valley cottage room
description: Isaac keeps a modest room in a valley cottage north of town. A few books on livestock sit on a shelf above a small desk with sale notes. A folded garden plan and his better clothes hang on a peg.
details: A leather-bound ledger with auction tallies rests on the desk beside a tin of pencils.
A wooden box of seed packets and a hand-drawn garden sketch sit on the windowsill.
A concertina in a worn case leans in the corner near the bed.
activities: Lay out a garden using the seed packets
Try a waltz on the concertina
windowOutlook: A low view across the cottage yard toward orchard rows and the river channel.
interiorStyle: Rectangular room with whitewashed walls, a narrow iron bed, a pine desk under the single window, cottonwood-green curtains, and a braided rug on the plank floor.

name: Jed’s room off Main Street
description: Jed keeps a small room off Main Street above the card room. Dusty boots stand by the door next to a washstand with an oil lamp. A straight chair holds his work clothes.
details: A bone-handled folding knife in a leather sheath lies on the washstand.
A small whiskey flask and two tin cups sit on a shelf above the bed.
A deck of worn playing cards in a wooden box rests on the nightstand.
activities: Play a round of draw poker
windowOutlook: A side view down the alley toward a neighboring porch and the brick side of the next building.
interiorStyle: Narrow room with brick-red plaster walls, a low brass bed against the back wall, a pine washstand near the door, faded indigo blanket, and a single straight chair under the oil lamp.

name: Josie's Lantern Row Room
description: A straight-backed chair holds a folded shawl and a pair of dusty boots on the floor beside it. A washstand with a tin basin stands under the window next to an oil lamp. The bed is covered with a checked cotton spread and a spare pillow.
details: A small dish on the washstand holds a few silver earrings and a key.
A half-empty bottle of whiskey sits on the floor near the chair leg.
A lace-trimmed chemise hangs from a hook on the back of the door.
activities: Try on a new piece of lace
windowOutlook: narrow alley between two wooden buildings with a clothesline across it
interiorStyle: compact room with faded rose wallpaper, a single oil lamp, and a trunk at the foot of the bed

name: June's Livery Room
residenceType: Livery cottage and separate forge room
description: A set of repaired harness straps and bridles hangs from pegs beside the door. A small desk holds a stack of folded race notices and a plain envelope tucked under a book. The bed is made with a faded indigo blanket and a single pillow.
details: A length of freshly oiled leather tack rests on the pegs with the stitching pulled tight.
The envelope on the desk contains a small roll of bills kept flat between two cards.
A well-used fiddle case leans against the foot of the bed.
activities: Tighten a stitch on the harness strap
Play a short tune on the fiddle
windowOutlook: quiet dirt yard with a split-rail fence and a single cottonwood tree
interiorStyle: small plank-walled room with a low ceiling, a kerosene lamp on the desk, and a braided rag rug beside the bed

name: Kit's Claim Cabin
description: A low bench along the wall holds rows of rock samples sorted by size and color. A battered songbook lies open on a stool near the bed. A thick wool blanket covers the narrow cot with a canvas coat folded at the foot.
details: A row of quartz and sandstone pieces lines the bench with labels written on scraps of paper.
The songbook pages show pencil marks beside several tunes.
A cast-iron skillet hangs from a nail above the small stove.
activities: Sing a song from the book
windowOutlook: open slope of red sandstone with scattered brush and a distant bluff
interiorStyle: rough plank cabin with a single window, a tin lantern on the bench, and a hide rug on the dirt floor

name: Lena's Valley Room
description: The room holds a wooden gear rack along one wall for river poles and lines. A small table near the window holds folded maps and a few charcoal sketches of bends in the river. A narrow bed sits against the opposite wall with a plain wool blanket.
details: A coil of oiled fishing line hangs from the gear rack with a few hooks still attached.
Several hand-drawn route maps lie flat on the table weighted by a river stone.
A mouth harp rests on the windowsill beside a tin of drawing charcoal.
activities: Trace a new river route on the maps
Play a tune on the mouth harp
windowOutlook: cottonwood trees along the irrigation ditch with a low adobe wall beyond
interiorStyle: narrow adobe room with cream plaster walls, a single brass lamp on the table, and a worn cotton curtain at the window

name: Lottie's room at Calder House
residenceType: Calder House staff and rented rooms
description: A narrow room above the mercantile holds a narrow bed pushed against the west wall and a trunk at its foot. Fashion plates lean against the mirror above a small table, and fabric scraps lie folded on a wooden chair. A ledger rests open beside a tin lamp.
details: A stack of theater playbills from the last traveling company sits on the windowsill.
A wooden box of straight pins and measuring tape rests on the table for quick alterations.
A pair of dancing slippers with worn soles stands beside the trunk.
activities: Pin and adjust a fabric remnant
windowOutlook: A narrow view of the brick side wall and a single cottonwood branch across the alley.
interiorStyle: Cream plaster walls with one faded indigo curtain, a brass bed frame, a pine table and chair, and a worn floor rug under the trunk.

name: Mabel's flat above Marigold House
description: A larger room with its own door holds a piano against the north wall and a reading chair near the window. Architectural sketches lie on a side table beside a potted geranium, and a row of well-made dresses hangs in the wardrobe.
details: A leather-bound book of poetry rests on the chair cushion.
A set of drafting tools and rolled sketches sits on the side table.
A watering can stands beside the geranium on the windowsill.
activities: Play a short piece on the piano
Look over the latest architectural sketch
windowOutlook: A view across the rear courtyard to the low garden fence and cottonwood trees.
interiorStyle: Cream plaster walls, a dark wood piano, a leather reading chair with brass tacks, patterned cotton curtains, and a worn but solid plank floor.

name: Marigold’s room in Lantern Row
description: A small room behind the main house contains a low bed with a faded blanket and a washstand in the corner. A brass lamp sits on a crate beside the bed, and a silk shawl hangs from a peg on the door. Boots rest by the threshold.
details: A small bottle of whiskey and two glasses stand on the crate next to the lamp.
A tin dish for rings and keys sits on the washstand.
A folded silk blouse lies inside the open trunk at the bed's foot.
activities: Make up a costume with the silk blouse
Trade saloon stories over a drink
windowOutlook: A slice of the dusty side yard and the neighboring porch railing.
interiorStyle: Plaster walls with brick-red trim, a single brass lamp, a pine crate table, a metal washstand, and a threadbare blanket on the bed.

name: Marisol’s room at the trading post
description: A square room at the rear of the trading post contains a bed with woven blankets and a small table holding a tin lamp. A locked cupboard stands against one wall, and a row of potted plants lines the sill under the window.
details: A bundle of letters tied with string sits on the table beside the lamp.
A guitar case leans against the foot of the bed.
A notebook of freight routes rests on the cupboard top.
activities: Trade verses of a song on the guitar
Plan a day trip along a freight route
windowOutlook: A compact view of the fenced garden plot and red sandstone slope beyond.
interiorStyle: Adobe walls with ochre plaster patches, a brass bed frame, a pine table and cupboard, woven wool blankets, and a checked curtain at the single window.

name: Elias’s hotel room
residenceType: Calder House staff and rented rooms
description: Elias Reddick keeps a private room at the Calder House hotel. A half-finished chair sits in pieces near the window and a row of history books lines the shelf above the washstand. Clean spare shirts hang on hooks behind the door.
details: A set of wood planes and chisels rests in a canvas roll on the dresser.
Three local history volumes stand upright on the narrow shelf.
A tin coffee pot sits on a trivet beside the lamp.
activities: Work on the loose chair leg together
Find a favorite story in the county history
windowOutlook: brick side wall and narrow alley with a single cottonwood visible at the corner
interiorStyle: rectangular hotel room with cream plaster walls, worn brass bed frame, tobacco-brown blanket, and a low table holding the coffee pot and a single oil lamp

name: Mateo’s room in the valley cottage
description: Mateo Varela keeps a private room inside a shared valley cottage. A guitar rests on a stand near the window and a stack of water ledgers sits on the corner table. The room opens onto a shaded step where he meets neighbors.
details: A well-tuned guitar leans against the wall beside the bed.
Bound irrigation ledgers fill a wooden crate under the table.
A tin watering can stands by the door with a folded cloth beside it.
activities: Pick out a valley tune on the guitar
Plan the next planting by the water notes
windowOutlook: low courtyard wall and cottonwood branches outside the single east window
interiorStyle: small square room with cream plaster walls, one brass lamp on the table, faded indigo blanket on the iron bed, and a single wooden chair pulled up to the ledger table

name: Minnie’s Cottonwood Valley room
description: Minnie has one good chair by the lamp and a tin box of old letters on her dresser. A bottle of whiskey sits on the low shelf. From the window you can see a fence and the fields of Cottonwood Valley.
details: A half-full bottle of widows' whiskey sits on the low shelf.
A tin box holding folded old letters rests on the dresser top.
A clean oil lamp with a clear chimney stands on the bedside table.
activities: Pick a favorite letter to read aloud
Tell a valley story over whiskey
windowOutlook: ranch yard fence and open valley fields beyond the single south window
interiorStyle: small square room with cream plaster walls, a narrow iron bed with a plain wool blanket, one wooden chair, and a pine dresser holding the tin box and lamp

name: Nate’s room on the east bank
description: Nathaniel Brooks keeps a modest private room above the railhead lodging house. A stack of travel letters sits beside a borrowed camera print on the table and a silver watch rests in a dish by the bed.
details: A bundle of folded travel letters tied with string lies on the table.
A single framed camera print leans against the wall near the lamp.
A polished silver pocket watch sits in a small wooden dish.
activities: Pick a rail trip from the timetable
windowOutlook: flat roof of the next building and open sky above the rail yard
interiorStyle: narrow rectangular room with ochre plaster walls, a single brass lamp, a plain pine table with two chairs, and a narrow bed covered by a faded indigo quilt

name: Nell’s courtyard room
description: Nell keeps a private room off the Salcedo courtyard in River Ward. A narrow bed stands along one wall with a small writing desk opposite it. A single window lets in daylight over the low adobe wall outside.
details: A wooden mechanical puzzle with brass gears sits on the desk beside her study notes.
A potted aloe in a clay pot rests on the sill, its leaves trimmed for salve.
A set of calligraphy pens and a bottle of ink stand in a small drawer under the desk.
activities: Solve the brass gear puzzle together
Trade names in your best calligraphy
windowOutlook: A low adobe wall and cottonwood branches against the sky above the courtyard.
interiorStyle: Plastered walls in cream with a faded indigo blanket on the bed, a pine desk and chair, a single oil lamp, and a trunk for clothes at the foot of the bed.

name: Pearl’s room above Lantern Court
description: Pearl keeps a private room above Lantern Court separate from her salon work. A bed with a plain cover and a small breakfast table stand near the window. A wooden box for letters sits on a low shelf.
details: A closed wooden box of letters rests on the shelf beside the bed.
Several small potted plants line the windowsill in mismatched clay pots.
A stack of folded informal dresses and a shawl hang from pegs on the wall.
activities: Read a poem over morning tea
Repot one of the windowsill plants
windowOutlook: The narrow lane behind Lantern Court and a neighbor's garden fence.
interiorStyle: Cream plaster walls with a tobacco-brown blanket on the bed, a simple pine table and two chairs, a single oil lamp, and a woven rug on the floor.

name: Rafael’s room at Calder House
residenceType: Calder House staff and rented rooms
description: Rafael keeps a private staff room at Calder House on Main Street. A narrow bed and a small table take up most of the space. A trunk holds his clothes and a folded map leans against the wall.
details: A folded travel map showing routes west of the river lies on the table.
A music booklet with handwritten notes rests beside a spare harmonica.
A small locked tin for savings sits under the folded shirts in the trunk.
activities: Pick a far-off stop on the travel map
Try a chorus on the harmonica
windowOutlook: The side alley and a neighboring rooftop with laundry lines.
interiorStyle: Cream plaster walls, a brass lamp on the table, a faded brick-red blanket on the bed, worn pine furniture, and a single chair pulled close to the table.

name: Jonah’s valley cottage room
description: Jonah keeps a modest private room in one of the valley cottages in River Ward. A bed and a well-used writing desk fill most of the space. Gardening boots stand by the door.
details: A stack of books on local history and church records sits on the desk.
A small collection of sheet music for hymns lies beside a wooden flute.
A pair of worn gardening boots rests by the door with dried mud on the soles.
activities: Play a hymn on the wooden flute
Find an old valley story to read aloud
windowOutlook: Open fields and the riverbank with cottonwoods in the distance.
interiorStyle: Cream plaster walls, a faded indigo blanket on the bed, a sturdy pine desk and chair, an oil lamp, and a small trunk for clothes under the window.

name: Rhett Avery's private room
description: Rhett Avery keeps a private room above a Main Street storefront. A narrow bed sits against the back wall with a wooden chair pulled close. A small table holds a bottle and glass near the single window.
details: A worn deck of cards with slightly bent corners rests on the table.
A brown glass whiskey bottle stands beside two mismatched glasses.
A folded map of the county roads lies on the chair seat.
activities: Practice a quick shuffle with the deck
Hum an old song while looking at the map
windowOutlook: Narrow view down the side alley toward the river terrace and cottonwood trees.
interiorStyle: Small square room with cream plaster walls, one brass oil lamp on the table, faded indigo blanket on the bed, scuffed floorboards, and a single hook for coats.

name: Rosalie Quinn's private room
description: Rosalie Quinn keeps a small room above Lantern Row. A traveling trunk stands open against the wall with a few folded garments inside. A narrow bed and a straight chair occupy most of the floor space.
details: A stack of song sheets lies on the trunk lid.
A tin coffee cup with a dented side sits on the windowsill.
A small sketchbook with a charcoal pencil rests on the chair.
activities: Hum a new song from the sheet music
windowOutlook: View of the adjacent building wall and a strip of sky above the rooftops.
interiorStyle: Compact room with cream plaster, one oil lamp, a brass bed frame, worn floorboards, and a patched mirror on the wall above the trunk.

name: Ruby’s ribbon-trimmed room
description: Ruby Fenwick keeps a private room in a Lantern Row boarding house. The bed is made with a plain quilt and a small trunk sits at the foot. A washstand holds a basin and a few folded ribbons.
details: A length of red ribbon is draped over the edge of the mirror frame.
A half-full whiskey bottle and tin cup sit on the washstand shelf.
A pair of soft dance slippers rests under the bed.
activities: Learn a dance step in her soft slippers
Try a ribbon two ways for a stage costume
windowOutlook: View across the narrow courtyard to the back windows of the next building.
interiorStyle: Rectangular room with brick-red walls, one oil lamp, a low cot with faded cotton cover, wooden trunk, and a small shelf holding a few personal items.

name: Ruth’s curtained room
description: Ruth Freeman keeps a private room in a River Ward boardinghouse. A bed with a sewn quilt stands against one wall and a small shelf holds a few books. A wooden chair and a washstand fill the remaining space.
details: A cloth-bound songbook lies open on the shelf.
A small ledger with a leather cover rests on the chair.
A sewing kit with thread spools sits beside the washstand.
activities: Sing a verse from the songbook in harmony
Teach a simple stitch on scrap cloth
windowOutlook: View of the river slope and the ferry landing below the boardinghouse.
interiorStyle: Rectangular room with ochre walls, one oil lamp, a simple wooden bed, checked curtains on the single window, and a clean plank floor.

name: Sabine’s room with the teal coverlet
residenceType: The Red Sash private resident rooms
description: Sabine keeps a private room at the Red Sash. A bed with a teal coverlet stands against one wall. Two locked boxes sit on a small desk beside a row of potted herbs on the windowsill.
details: A stack of French and English novels rests on the desk.
A ledger book with a leather strap lies next to the locked boxes.
Three clay herb pots line the windowsill.
activities: Compare a favorite line in French and English
Pick herbs for a pot of tea
windowOutlook: A view of the alley behind the building and the neighboring roofline.
interiorStyle: A narrow room with painted board walls, a bed with a teal coverlet, a small desk under the window, a wooden chair, and a single oil lamp on the desk.

name: Station room at Mule Camp
description: Sadie keeps a private room at the coach station. A folding supper table stands against one wall when not in use. Maps and a stack of postcards sit on a shelf above a wooden trunk.
details: A heavy traveling coat with brass buttons hangs on a hook by the door.
A deck of cards in a tin case rests on the corner of the table.
A small cast-iron skillet sits on a shelf near the window.
activities: Play a few hands of cards
Look over a route on the map
windowOutlook: A side view of the coach yard with two parked wagons and a line of cottonwoods beyond.
interiorStyle: A compact room with plank walls, a low cot on one side, a folding table in the center, a single shelf, and a small iron stove in the corner.

name: Samuel’s room in the river cottage
description: Samuel keeps a private room in the river cottage. A small table holds a stack of crossing records. A music book and a drawer with a boat plan sit near the hearth.
details: A pair of carefully maintained boots stands by the door.
An old music book with handwritten notes lies on the table.
A rolled boat plan tied with string rests in the open drawer.
activities: Trace a crossing on the old boat plan
Sing a river song from his music book
windowOutlook: A low view across the riverbank with willows and the water's edge visible.
interiorStyle: A single room with adobe walls, a stone hearth on the right, a narrow bed against the back wall, a wooden table near the window, and a plank floor.

name: Canvas room at Crowcut Hollow
description: Silas keeps a private canvas-and-board room inside the old loading shelter. A sturdy plank table holds freight ledgers and an oil lamp. A locked chest sits under the cot for papers and a battered chess set rests on a crate beside the bed.
details: An old songbook with a cracked leather cover lies open on the writing table.
A worn saddle blanket hangs on a peg near the door.
A wooden chessboard with carved pieces sits ready on a low crate.
activities: Work through a chess problem together
Sing an old song from the book
windowOutlook: A narrow view of the hollow's dirt yard and the base of a sandstone bluff.
interiorStyle: One small room with board walls and canvas roof, a plank table against the back wall, a narrow cot on the left, a single oil lamp, and a worn canvas tarp over the floor.

name: Tess's Eastbank Room
description: Tess keeps a private room in the east-bank lodging house. Rolled survey maps lean against one wall and a camp stool sits near the small table. A field book with pressed wildflowers lies open on the bed.
details: A charcoal drawing in a simple wooden frame hangs above the bed showing the river bend.
A wooden mechanical puzzle with interlocking pieces rests on the table.
A pair of riding gloves hangs from a peg beside the door.
activities: Look at the pressed wildflowers in the field book
windowOutlook: The window looks out on the neighboring lodging roof and a line of cottonwood trees along the riverbank.
interiorStyle: A compact square room with rough plank walls, a single bed with a canvas cover, a folding camp stool, a small table, and a peg rail for clothes.

name: Tom's Eastbank Room
description: Tom keeps a private room in the same east-bank lodging house as Tess. Architectural sketches lie stacked on a crate and a mended work jacket hangs on the back of the chair. Music notices are pinned to the wall near the bed.
details: A set of charcoal pencils and a sketch pad sit on the crate beside the sketches.
A small wooden flute rests on the windowsill next to a stack of folded shirts.
A leather riding crop leans in the corner by the door.
activities: Try a tune on the wooden flute
windowOutlook: The window shows the dusty yard between the lodging house and the next building with a few workers' tents beyond.
interiorStyle: A narrow rectangular room with unfinished plank walls, a low bed with a brown blanket, a wooden crate for a table, one straight chair, and a peg rail holding the jacket.

name: Trixie’s room off Lantern Row
description: Trixie keeps a small private room off Lantern Row. A worn blanket covers the bed and a tin basin sits on the wash stand. Boots rest by the threshold beside a simple chair.
details: A small tin box for coins and jewelry sits on the wash stand.
A folded dance shawl with fringe lies at the foot of the bed.
A bottle of whiskey and two glasses stand on the floor beside the chair.
activities: Practice a turn with the fringed shawl
Play heads or tails for the next song
windowOutlook: The window shows the narrow alley behind the buildings and the side wall of the next structure.
interiorStyle: A small square room with faded cream plaster walls, a narrow bed with a brown blanket, a wooden wash stand, one chair, and a hook on the wall for clothes.

name: Vera's Bluff Room
description: Vera keeps a private room above the coach station on the bluff. The space holds her assay books in neat rows on a plank shelf and a small wooden game board on the table. A narrow bed stands against the back wall under a single oil lamp.
details: A set of mineral sample jars sits on the windowsill with handwritten labels on each lid.
A folded music booklet rests beside the game board with handwritten chord notes in the margins.
A pair of sturdy hiking boots stands by the door with dried mud still on the soles.
activities: Play a round on the game board
Look through the mineral sample jars
windowOutlook: The window shows the rocky ridge line turning orange at dusk with scattered scrub brush below.
interiorStyle: A single rectangular room with whitewashed plank walls, a narrow bed with a faded indigo blanket, a wooden table and two straight chairs, a shelf of books, and an oil lamp on the table.

name: Victor Halden's hotel room
residenceType: Calder House staff and rented rooms
description: Victor keeps a private room on the second floor of Calder House. A narrow desk holds a stack of rolled maps and a brass inkstand. A leather trunk sits at the foot of the bed.
details: A leather-bound book of building plans lies open on the desk beside a straightedge.
A polished wooden box contains a deck of cards with worn edges.
A small framed photograph of a distant train station leans against the wall above the trunk.
activities: Compare building plans on the desk
Play a hand of cards at the table
windowOutlook: A narrow view of the next brick building and a strip of cottonwood leaves along the alley.
interiorStyle: A compact hotel room with cream plaster walls, a brass bed, a walnut desk, and a single oil lamp. The floor is bare boards with a faded indigo rug. A locked cabinet stands against one wall.

name: Violet’s room by the stove
description: Violet keeps a private room behind the bakery on Main Street. A narrow cot is pushed against the wall. A small iron stove and a single chair occupy the center of the floor.
details: A tin of matches and a bundle of kindling sit in a bucket beside the stove.
A dark glass bottle of wine stands on a shelf above the chair.
A small leather-bound hymnbook rests on the windowsill.
activities: Trade favorite verses from the hymnbook
Open the wine and tell a fireside story
windowOutlook: A high view of the alley and the brick wall of the next building.
interiorStyle: A compact room with cream plaster walls, a worn plank floor, and a single oil lamp on a wall bracket. The cot has a faded blanket. A wooden crate serves as a table.

name: Gin Maddox's upstairs room
description: Gin keeps a private room above the Copper Mare. A small upright piano stands against the far wall with a practice book on the bench. A sturdy oak table holds a stack of mending supplies.
details: A set of sandpaper and wood glue sits in a canvas pouch beside the table.
A stack of sheet music is held down by a brass candlestick on the piano.
A polished wooden box contains a pair of opera glasses.
activities: Play a piece from the practice book
Sand a small table leg together
windowOutlook: A view of the street lanterns and the roofline of the neighboring building.
interiorStyle: A square room with warm lamplight, mustard walls, and a braided rug. The bed is covered with a checked quilt. A repaired armchair sits near the piano, and a locked chest stands by the door.

name: Wes Archer's private room
description: Wes keeps a small room above a boarding house in River Ward. A rope coil and a tin of grease sit on a low shelf. An oil lamp hangs from a hook near the single window.
details: A set of knotted rope samples hangs from a peg beside the door.
A battered tin cup and a half-empty bottle of whiskey rest on the washstand.
A folded chart of river depths lies under the bed frame.
activities: Compare knots on the rope samples
Trace river depths on the chart
windowOutlook: A low view across a dusty yard to the riverbank and a line of willows.
interiorStyle: A narrow room with plank walls, a low iron bed, a single chair, and a pine washstand. The blanket is faded indigo. A brass hook holds a lantern and a spare shirt.

name: Wren’s Main Street room
description: Wren Keene keeps a narrow room above a shop on Main Street. A single bed takes the back wall beside a washstand and a small table with two straight chairs. An oil lamp hangs from a hook, and a row of pegs holds work clothes and a spare hat.
details: A corked bottle of red wine rests on the table next to two tin cups.
A leather notebook with loose pages of quick ink drawings sits on the windowsill.
A tin plate and fork from a late breakfast remain on the washstand.
activities: Sketch each other in the ink notebook
Choose a sketch to turn into a print
windowOutlook: Main Street below with wagons passing and cottonwood branches at the edge of the frame.
interiorStyle: A compact rectangular room with cream plaster walls showing cracks and nail holes, a scuffed plank floor, a narrow iron bed frame with a faded indigo blanket, a pine table and chairs, and a single oil lamp casting warm light.
